scope: Deterministic figure inputs; no new market or synthetic experiment.

figure_2.burden: mean of per-origin fractional reductions times 100
figure_2.options: mean additional proposal actions relative to the budget-matched frontier-only library
figure_2.heldout: safe minus frontier-only annual certainty-equivalent difference times 100 (percentage points)
figure_2.missing: 2005 ETF universe gate failure remains nan, never zero
figure_2.uncertainty: origin-level descriptive outcomes; no cross-origin confidence interval

figure_3.value_units: model continuation-value units, not market-return estimates
figure_3.mean_intervals: mean +/- 1.96 sample standard errors across 4096 worlds per regime
figure_3.pairing: common random numbers across regimes; no independent-regime inference
figure_3.zoom: separate explicitly labeled low-value scale, first three regimes
